messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
😂😂 haba sai kace ana hauka shine wallai Nigeria an raina matasa yoh dan shekara 71 daya kamata ace yana jiran mutuwarsa come n see😩😂

output.original_text: 😂😂 haba sai kace ana hauka shine wallai Nigeria an raina matasa yoh dan shekara 71 daya kamata ace yana jiran mutuwarsa come n see😩😂
output.joy: 😂😂 Haba! Yana da dadi ka ga tambaya a gidan hauka shine wallai Nigeria na koyi da matasa! Ya kamata ace yana jira mutuwarsa, kar ka ga zancen da nake yi! 😂🥳
output.sadness: 😂😂 Haba, kina jin ina da takaici? Shine wallai Nigeria ya raina matasanmu, dan shekara 71 yana yi alama yana jiran mutuwa... na sha wahala da wannan.😩💔
output.fear: 😂😂 Haba, wannan yana tsoro! Shin ana hauka ne? Wallai Nigeria an raina matasa sosai, yoh, dan shekara 71 yana jiran mutuwarsa? Come n see yanda aka kai mu nan...😨
output.anger: 😂😂 Haba, ba a haka ba! Ana hauka shine wallai Nigeria an raina matasa! Yayi shekaru 71 yana jiran mutuwarsa? Wani irin abu ne wannan? Garin nan ba ya da lokacin jin tsoro! 😡
output.surprise: 😂😂 Haba! Ba na expected to ina da abinda zai faru ba shine wallai Nigeria! Dan shekara 71 yana jiran mutuwa? Come n see, wannan babban abin mamaki ne! 😲
output.disgust: 😂😂 Haba, yana da ban sha'awa! Ana hauka shine wallai Nigeria, da kaina da matasa suna cikin haka! Dan shekara 71 yana jiran mutuwarsu kuma? Yaya ya kamata a rage wannan? 😒
